rules.title: Write supplied emphasis in two visibly different space grades while keeping every ordinary word.
rules.registry_status: Imported unreviewed, RAW INCOMPLETE, not selected. The record is not upgraded by this review.
rules.human_purpose: Preserve how the author emphasizes a meaningful sentence without hiding its ordinary words or relying on a whole-sentence mnemonic table.
rules.hand_rule: The input supplies every literal word and one explicit emphasis bit per word. Write each word fully. Put a narrow gap before emphasis0 and a broad gap before emphasis1. Broad gaps begin primary groups; narrow gaps continue them. Preserve the same grade as indentation from a common left margin after a line wrap. A blank row marks a paragraph. An initial unaccented run is legal and has its own initial group. No lexical list or hidden counter decides the emphasis.

full_manual_example.readback: Both restore exactly the same ordinary wording and punctuation; they restore different explicitly supplied emphasis. N/W are teaching labels for actual narrow/broad gaps, not free inserted words or proposed Voynich signs. No source corpus or native form was used for this example.

rules.short_words_repeat_and_interior: A single emphasized short word forms a short group. Two equal emphasized words can form identical consecutive groups. Unknown and long words are copied fully. The module imposes no three-sign medial palette; however, because its22-sign body script remains unspecified, an actual glyph realization with particular short-word lengths or interior diversity has NOT been constructed. Open vocabulary is allowed; this is not itself a new source-language word-formation grammar.
rules.learning_and_writing_cost: Ordinary language and full word script; two visible gap grades; common margin; paragraph marks; line-opening indentation rule. One additional bit per word is physically paid by space. Wide gaps consume writing area. There is no learned whole-word code table or implicit source answer. Overwide individual words still lack an internal continuation rule.
rules.strongest_unresolved_problem: The old source projections do not supply independent authorial emphasis, and existing transcription groups are not these hypothetical primary groups. Choosing bits to obtain desired frequencies or treating narrow visible source-word gaps as if they vanished would violate this RAW contract. A changed grouping under unchanged inputs or an unreadable gap/indent distinction fails the exact rule. This is a conditional source-side consequence, not a native test selected here.

rules.title: Inside one word, copy the immediately preceding three to eight source characters with a paid length command.
rules.registry_status: Imported unreviewed, RAW INCOMPLETE, not selected. Its original card already states the1202 exclusion of unchanged whole-word use; unreviewed must not mean unaffected by existing evidence.
rules.human_purpose: Shorten repeated spelling inside open ordinary words without learning a dictionary of words or substrings and without remembering earlier complete words.
rules.hand_rule: Start every word with empty memory. Keep at most the last eight decoded source characters. At the current source position, if its next n characters equal the immediately previous n characters for n=3..8, write COPY(n) for the greatest legal n. Otherwise write the next character literally. A copy reads a snapshot that was already present; it does not overlap its own output. Preserve every source word boundary and reset memory there. Six commands plus the complete literal alphabet are required.

rules.short_words_repeat_and_interior: Single characters and short words can remain literal. abab remains literal because the repeated piece has length2. An entire source word repeated next to itself has the same output twice, because each word resets its own scratch window; no common interword repeat header appears. Literal long words can use many distinct source characters, so the algorithm has no three-symbol interior restriction. Its actual22-sign literals/commands are nevertheless unpaid; possible source diversity is not an established native surface fit.
rules.learning_and_writing_cost: Know the ordinary language and82-character declared input domain; learn six length commands and a full literal/escape script. The writer checks at most six local candidate blocks; the reader counts back at most eight recovered characters. Canonicality requires another scan. A literal source string C3 must be distinguishable from the command C3. No cross-word memory, semantic roots, letter-value state or global word table is used. Long nonrepeating words receive no saving, and overwide-word continuation remains unspecified.
rules.strongest_unresolved_problem: A uniquely readable, non-erasing22-sign carrier must separate82 literal values from six commands and pay all escapes. More decisively for the existing four source projections, the deterministic per-word inverse preserves the entire whole-word frequency partition.1202 already rules out this unchanged one-source-word/one-group conjunction; constructing its alphabet or recounting the same sources cannot change that decision. rules.concrete_falsifier_if_later_selected: A leading COPY(n), a command with fewer than n prior decoded characters, or failure to use the greatest mandatory local tandem is illegal. Native application would need a justified literal/control carrier and true aligned unit boundaries. A repeated visible substring alone is not such a binding.
